title: Change conditions for a general boat driving licence
summary: General boat driving licence holders must notify Transport for NSW of any changes to medical or physical conditions that affect their fitness to operate a vessel.
intro:
If you're the holder of a general boat driving licence, you must notify Transport for NSW of any changes to medical or physical conditions (including eyesight), that might cast doubt on your fitness to operate a vessel.

You can visit a Service NSW Centre and provide the information in person, or post your documents to us.
who_can_apply: Holders of a general boat driving licence who have changes to medical or physical conditions (including eyesight).

If you hold a general boat driving licence and also hold a NSW driver licence, vehicle registration, or combined licence, you must complete the 'Change of Records – Transport for NSW Products – PDF' form and provide the information in person at a service centre.
what_you_need: Supporting documentation for eyesight changes (e.g., a copy of both sides of your pensioner concession card)
The PDF form: Change of Records – Maritime Products Only

how_to_steps.text: Make sure that you have all the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and provide the information in person, or mail the documentation to:Service NSWAgency Business CentrePO Box 21ParkesNSW 2870

more_info.text: an eyesight test may be conducted at the service centre
changes to eyesight conditions will require a replacement licence
if you hold an unrestricted NSW driver licence (all classes) and a NSW adult boat licence, you may be eligible to combine these 2 licences on one card.

faqs.q: How do I notify Transport for NSW of a change in my medical or physical condition?
faqs.a: You can visit a Service NSW Centre in person or post your documents to the Agency Business Centre at PO Box 21, Parkes NSW 2870.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply or notify changes?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, your general boat driving licence, and supporting documentation if you are adding or removing an eyesight condition (such as a copy of both sides of your pensioner concession card or the 'Change of Records – Maritime Products Only' PDF form).

faqs.q: Who needs to notify Transport for NSW of changes?
faqs.a: Any holder of a general boat driving licence must notify Transport for NSW if there are changes to medical or physical conditions that might cast doubt on their fitness to operate a vessel.
